items.item_text: Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Previous experience in Payroll or Finance desired

Under direct supervision, serves as an entry-level financial services professional who learns to use established financial services concepts, policies, and procedures to perform routine payroll and financial processing tasks. Works on assignments that are initially limited in scope and complexity, following standard practices and receiving regular guidance and review. Apply organizational policies and defined procedures to review payroll and timekeeping data for accuracy, perform data entry, basic reconciliations, and routine error resolution, escalating non-standard or complex issues to higher-level analysts. Responds to routine customer and departmental inquiries related to payroll and timekeeping systems and refers complex matters for additional review. Supports payroll operations with attention to detail, accuracy, confidentiality, and adherence to collective bargaining agreements and applicable regulatory and policy requirements. Utilizes multiple systems and platforms, including PeopleSoft and related applications, to complete assigned tasks. Works cooperatively as part of a team, demonstrating initiative, clear communication, and flexibility in adapting to changing priorities and operational needs. Shares responsibility for coverage during high-volume periods, provides reliable customer service, and contributes to departmental knowledge-sharing. Participates in training and development activities to acquire the skills and knowledge necessary for increasingly independent work. Performs special projects and other related duties as assigned.

60% - Processes biweekly and monthly payroll for School of Medicine, Network, and Primary Care Hospital employees by reviewing time and attendance data for accuracy, performing routine payroll transactions and data entry, completing reconciliations, preparing final pay and other recurring payroll tasks, and processing off-cycle and ad hoc payments in accordance with standard practices.
40% - Customer service, payroll related data reports and other tasks
Proficiency using ERP systems (ex: Peoplesoft), spreadsheets, and database software.
Proficiency in analyzing financial data and reconciling accounts.
Proficiency in spreadsheet and database software (e.g., Excel, financial systems).
Basic knowledge of payroll, financial, or accounting concepts processes and procedures.
Basic knowledge of financial and accounting concepts, processes, and procedures.
Basic mathematical skills and order operations concepts to calculate timesheets.
Ability to work accurately under deadlines and manage multiple financial tasks.

Interpersonal skills, service orientation, active listening, critical thinking, attention to detail, ability to multi-task in a high-volume environment, effective verbal and written communication skills and organizational skills.
Strong organizational, analytical, and communication skills.
Basic knowledge and understanding of internal control practices and their impacts on protecting university resources.
Ability to function effectively as part of a financial services team and collaborate with multiple stakeholders.
